input: root is null or the root of a finite, acyclic binary tree with no shared child nodes. TreeNode is a caller-supplied ordinary object with data fields val, left and right, without getters, proxies or concurrent mutation. Every child is a TreeNode or the null. Node values are plain integers in [-9007199254740991, 9007199254740991]. There are at most 4294967295 nodes. String inputs, when present, are primitive strings, not boxed strings. Integer values are primitive safe-integer Number, excluding negative zero, NaN, infinities, fractions and BigInt. Arrays are dense ordinary Arrays, not sparse arrays, proxies, subclasses or accessor-backed collections. There is no concurrent mutation or monkey-patching of standard built-ins. Preconditions are not checked at runtime. Allocation and runtime resource limits still require qualification; this declared domain is not a capacity or completion guarantee.
return: A fresh outer Array of fresh level Arrays, ordered deepest level first and root level last. Values within every level retain left-to-right tree order. The absent root returns a fresh empty outer Array.
mutation_aliasing: No node, value or child link is written. Input identities and caller-held aliases remain intact; local queues/stacks borrow node references only. The Solution instance retains no state. Only the newly allocated outer level sequence is reversed. Every inner level is distinct and contains immutable value copies, not node references; no result aliases the queue or an input object. Separate calls allocate independent results.
numeric: Node values are copied without arithmetic. Queue head, queue length, level endpoints and output lengths remain exact integers bounded by node count. Reversing the outer sequence changes order only.
complexity: O(n + 1) time and O(n + 1) auxiliary space, plus O(n + 1) output storage. The append-only queue retains all discovered node references and is not O(width) space. One final outer reversal costs O(h), where h is the number of levels and h <= n. No recursion or front removal/insertion is used.
source_accounting: The complete standalone source is 705 UTF-8 bytes, including the Solution class, method signature, every loop, condition, allocation, standard built-in call, annotation/comment where present, whitespace and terminal newline. There are no custom helper definitions, imports, generated implementations or hidden source expansion. Built-in operations are not free: their allocations and work are included in the stated runtime/storage costs. TreeNode, where used, is an explicit caller-owned input shape and no node is constructed. Any eventual judge-interface adapter is additional charged source; method-style interface parity with frozen sources remains unqualified.
